claims.text: Seed product 3 is 'Tai nghe' at 890000 VND. PATCH /api/v1/products/3 {"priceVnd": 950000} changes its price, staff only (StaffOnly policy); the cached product:3 is deleted after the save, so the next read loads the new price.

A queued order keeps the items with the prices the customer saw (create order screen: one item, unitPriceVnd = product.priceVnd) and is sent with them; sendNow only sends orders whose status is waiting.

From stage-3 POST /api/v1/orders still accepts unitPriceVnd but ignores it: RequestedItem has product and quantity only, and OrderService takes each price from Catalog through IProductPrices.CurrentPriceAsync.
A product Catalog does not know makes PlaceOrderAsync throw before anything is saved; the API answers 400 with the problem's detail (e.g. 'product 3 does not exist').
The 201 answer's items carry the price charged (ToDto: UnitPrice.Amount as unitPriceVnd); from stage-3 the app reads them into OrderResult.items.
QueuedOrder.priceChanged is true when the order has a result and totalVnd(result.items) != totalVnd(items); totalVnd adds quantity × unitPriceVnd over the items.

Each queued order is a StatusBanner (StatusTone info/success/warning/error, at most one action). Sent + priceChanged: warning tone with both totals (queuedPriceChanged), else success with queuedSent; rejected: its problem in error tone with a Remove action calling queue.remove.

queue is read with ref.read(orderQueueProvider.notifier); OrderQueue.remove(idempotencyKey) drops the entry with that key. A rejected order is removed only that way (the Remove action); sendNow skips it.
A resend with an Idempotency-Key the same customer already used gets the earlier stored order back, with its stored prices.

test/queue_sync_test.dart at stage-3 has 8 tests and passes. With priceChanged returning false, 'flags an order whose price changed while it waited' (Expected: true, Actual: <false>) and the widget test fail; 6 pass.
The failing widget test looks for text containing 'the price changed: you saw 2,000 VND, the order costs 2,400 VND' (English locale, 2 × 1,000 seen, 2 × 1,200 charged).

When staff set prices in Catalog and the customer chooses only product and quantity, the server's current price should decide a queued order's price, and the app should show the difference instead of hiding it.

Last-write-wins suits a record only one person edits (the last write is that person's latest decision); it does not suit a value two people decide, like this order's price, since the write arriving last can carry the older value.
A sync conflict needs no two edits of the same record: an offline copy stretches the window to however long the device was offline.

claims.text: An order sent after a price change gets the price-changed warning on Waiting orders, showing the seen total and the higher charged total (app_en.arb: 'you saw {seen} VND, the order costs {charged} VND').

beyond_scope: Notes that the comparison is on totals, equal to comparing prices at stage-3 because each order holds one product (DECISIONS 2026-10-06, repo-stage note).
